title: Cloud GPU Rendering Scheduling Problem (CGRSP): A Mathematical Formulation and Empirical Evaluation on Heterogeneous GPU Fleets
description:
This thesis formulates the Cloud GPU Rendering Scheduling Problem (CGRSP): assigning batch 3D rendering jobs, one frame per job, to heterogeneous on-demand GPUs under uncertain node availability and mixed deadlines. It evaluates waiting time and missed soft deadlines before rental cost.

The deposit contains the thesis PDF and LaTeX source, a Python discrete-event simulator with ten thesis scheduling policies and the baseline policies added for the journal, the 6,234-job calibration dataset, the simulation outputs, the generated tables and figures, and a one-command reproduction script.

The code is MIT licensed. The thesis text, PDF, and dataset are copyright 2026 Michael and are provided for academic reproducibility.
